Function to plot sbs96
```{r}
getSBSorder <- function() {
    counter <- 1
    df <- as.data.frame(matrix(data = NA, nrow = 96, ncol = 3))
    all_bp <- c("A", "C", "G", "T")
    pyr_muts <- c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")
    for(m in pyr_muts){
      for(a in all_bp){
        for(b in all_bp){
          df[counter,1] <- paste(a, "[",m, "]", b, sep="")
          df[counter,2] <- m
          df[counter,3] <- paste(a, substring(m,1,1),b, sep="")
          counter <- counter + 1 ## Add counter for next row
        }
      }
    }
    return(df)
  }

sbs.df <- getSBSorder()

mut.color <- c('deepskyblue','black','red','lightgrey','yellowgreen','pink')

## Function to plot SBS96
plotSBS <- function(df, x.label, y.label, alpha = 1, strip.color = "white", strip.size = 3.5) {
  df.pd <- df %>% left_join(x = ., y = sbs.df, by = c("MutationType"="V1"))
  df.pd$MutationType <- factor(x = df.pd$MutationType, levels = sbs.df$V1)

  # anno <- df.pd %>% dplyr::filter(V2 == "T>G") %>%
  #   mutate(x = Inf,
  #          y = Inf,
  #          label = paste0("Total: ", round(sum(df.pd$value), digits = 0))
  #          )

  p1 <- ggplot(data = df.pd, aes(x = MutationType, y = value/sum(value)*100)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = V2), alpha = alpha) +
    theme_bw() +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mut.color) +
    facet_wrap2(.~V2, nrow = 1, scale = "free_x", drop = TRUE,
                strip = strip_themed(
                background_x = list(
                  element_rect(fill = mut.color[1], color = "transparent"),
                  element_rect(fill = mut.color[2], color = "transparent"),
                  element_rect(fill = mut.color[3], color = "transparent"),
                  element_rect(fill = mut.color[4], color = "transparent"),
                  element_rect(fill = mut.color[5], color = "transparent"),
                  element_rect(fill = mut.color[6], color = "transparent")
                  ),
                text_x = list(
                  element_text(color = strip.color, face = "bold", size = strip.size, margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1))
                  )
                )) +
    # geom_text(data = anno, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.4,
    #           vjust = 1.1,
    #           hjust = 1.1) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(sbs.df$V3, sbs.df$V1)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ylab(y.label) + xlab(x.label) +
    theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 3),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8))
}

## Function to plot SBS96
plotSBSnostrip <- function(df, x.label, y.label, alpha = 1, strip.color = "white", strip.size = 3.5) {
  df.pd <- df %>% left_join(x = ., y = sbs.df, by = c("MutationType"="V1"))
  df.pd$MutationType <- factor(x = df.pd$MutationType, levels = sbs.df$V1)

  # anno <- df.pd %>% dplyr::filter(V2 == "T>G") %>%
  #   mutate(x = Inf,
  #          y = Inf,
  #          label = paste0("Total: ", round(sum(df.pd$value), digits = 0))
  #          )

  p1 <- ggplot(data = df.pd, aes(x = MutationType, y = value/sum(value)*100)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = V2), alpha = alpha) +
    theme_bw() +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mut.color) +
    facet_wrap2(.~V2, nrow = 1, scale = "free_x", drop = TRUE,
                strip = strip_themed(
                background_x = list(
                  element_blank(), element_blank(), element_blank(), element_blank(), element_blank(), element_blank()
                  ),
                text_x = list(
                  element_text(color = strip.color, face = "bold", size = strip.size, margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1))
                  )
                )) +
    # geom_text(data = anno, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.4,
    #           vjust = 1.1,
    #           hjust = 1.1) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(sbs.df$V3, sbs.df$V1)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ylab(y.label) + xlab(x.label) +
    theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 3),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8))
}
```

```{r}
## Load SBS192 mut catalogue
ds_sbs192 <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/output/SBS/UC_AA.SBS288.all") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(pattern = "N:", x = MutationType))
## Load SBS96 mut catalogue
ds_sbs96 <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/output/SBS/UC_AA.SBS96.all") %>% as.data.frame()

## SBS192 mutation count matrix
ds_sbs192_count <- ds_sbs192 %>% remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "MutationType") %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "Blood|Urine", x = Samples)) %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples) ~ "B",
                          grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples) ~ "U"),
         group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))),
         newName = paste0(group, type)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "newName") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Samples, -type, -group) %>% 
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "MutationType")

## Collapse SBS192 to SBS6
ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6 <- ds_sbs192_count %>%
  mutate(type = gsub(pattern = ".*\\[", replacement = "", x = MutationType),
         type = gsub(pattern = "\\].*", replacement = "", x = type),
         strand = gsub(pattern = "\\:.*", replacement = "", x = MutationType)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-MutationType) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(strand, type) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                ~ .x / sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

## Factor order
ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$strand <- factor(x = ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$strand, levels = rev(c("T", "U")))
ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$type <- factor(x = ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6$type,
                                         levels = rev(c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")))
```

Plot sbs96 (left) and sbs6 (right). Everything is hardcoded. 
```{r}
## UC7
p1 <- plotSBS(df = data.frame(MutationType = ds_sbs96$MutationType, 
                              value = ds_sbs96$UC7_Blood), 
              x.label = "UC7", y.label = "Blood", strip.size = 4) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 1.5),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

p12 <- ds_sbs192_collapsed_sbs6 %>% dplyr::select(strand, type, UC7B) %>% 
  'colnames<-' (c("strand", "type", "value")) %>%
  ggplot(data = ., aes(x = value, y = type, fill = strand)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("T" = "#014666", "U" = "#E42926"),
                    breaks = c("T", "U")) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8,
           position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 3),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.05, "cm"),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 3, margin = margin(l = 0)),
        legend.position = c(1.1, -0.15),
        legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0))

plot1 <- p1 + p12 + plot_layout(width = c(1, 0.3))

uc7 <- plot_spacer() / plot1 / plot_spacer() +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.2, 1, 0.2))
```
